welcome.body: Build a pattern, hit start, and we'll keep your place — row by row, repeat by repeat. Both hands free for the needles.
welcome.languageSwitchHint: You can switch anytime in Settings.

home.title: Hey, Knitter
home.castOnSub: Build your pattern step by step.
home.emptyHint: No projects yet. Cast on your first one above!

library.title: Library
library.emptyState: Nothing here yet. Create your first item above!
library.deletePatternBody: This pattern will be removed from your library. The sequences it uses stay put.
library.deleteSequenceBody: This sequence will be removed from your library. Patterns referencing it may break.
library.deleteRowBody: This row will be removed from your library.
library.patternEmpty: This pattern has no sequences yet.
library.notFound: This item isn't in your library anymore.

libraryCreate.newRowSub: A single line of stitches — saved once, reused across every project.
libraryCreate.newSeqSub: A stack of rows — a rib, a body, a border — saved together as one block.
libraryCreate.newPatternSub: The whole make — parts, each with its own sequences. Your master recipe.
libraryCreate.notationFootnote: We write it for you. Tap to fix a word if your shorthand differs.
libraryCreate.tapToAddRow: Tap to add to this row ✱
libraryCreate.tipRows: Tap any row to focus it — the stitch dock fills that row.
libraryCreate.tipParts: A scarf is one part. A cardigan is three. Drag parts to set your knitting order.
libraryCreate.editRowSub: Tweak the stitches, then save back into your library.
libraryCreate.editSeqSub: Tweak the rows, then save back into your library.
libraryCreate.editPatternSub: Tweak the parts and sequences, then save back into your library.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeBlurbMid: follows your phone's system setting — light by day, dark at night.
settings.themeBlurbTail: shifts everything to a deep warm red so your eyes stay relaxed during late-night knit-alongs.
settings.languagePickerSub: Pick the language YarnLog speaks to you in.
settings.cloudBody: Still on the needles — cross-device sync and cloud backup is coming in a future updates. For now, your projects stay snug right here on this device.
settings.resetDataBody: Removes every project and your custom library and stitches. Your theme, language, and preferences are kept. Useful if something looks broken — or you just want a clean slate.
settings.shareMessage: I've been using YarnLog to track my knitting & crochet projects — thought you might like it too. 🧶

knitting.emptyRow: No stitches defined for this row.
knitting.catCaption: press & hold so your cat can't ruin everything

wizard.step1Sub: Name it, pick your yarn and your tool — we'll remember.
wizard.step2Sub: A cardigan has a body and two sleeves. A scarf has one part. You decide.
wizard.step3Sub: Pick a part, then fill each sequence's rows. Scroll through them all.
wizard.step4Sub: Drag to order. Set repeats. Loop if it tubes.
wizard.blocked: Fill the required fields to continue.
wizard.nameStateEmpty: Give it a name — anything will do.
wizard.nameStateOk: Looks good. Future-you will thank you.
wizard.nameStateOver: Whoops — too long. I have to stop you.
wizard.nameStateRequired: This one's required — give your project a name to cast on.
wizard.step2EmptyBody: Scarves, dishcloths, blankets, simple hats — they're a single piece, and YarnLog's happy with that. Add more parts only if your project splits into separate pieces, like sleeves, panels, or a pocket.
wizard.step2DecorativeNote: ✻ one part is a whole project ✻
wizard.step2EmptyTipBody: Knit a sample first, then come back and split it if you need to. You can add parts at any time.
wizard.step2PopulatedTipBody: Drag to reorder. Knit them in whatever order makes sense — YarnLog only tracks one part at a time.
wizard.partNotesPlaceholder: e.g. 'knit in the round, switch to DPN at decreases'
wizard.removeWarning_one: Its {{count}} sequence will stay in your Library.
wizard.removeWarning_other: Its {{count}} sequences will stay in your Library.
wizard.step3EmptyRow: empty · tap a stitch below to start filling
wizard.step3TipBody: Tap any row to focus it — the stitch dock fills that row.
wizard.step3MarkStart: Tap the first stitch of the repeat
wizard.step3MarkEnd: Tap the last stitch of the repeat
wizard.step3MarkStartInRow: Tap the first stitch that repeats
wizard.step3MarkEndInRow: Now tap the last stitch that repeats
wizard.step3MarkStartHint: Stitches before your tap stay as a fixed edge.
wizard.step3MarkEndHint: Stitches after your tap become the “to last N” edge — set automatically.
wizard.removeRowBody: The rows above and below will shift up — neighboring rows aren't affected.
wizard.removeSeqBody: Every row inside moves with it. Other sequences in this part shift up — they aren't affected.
wizard.step4LoopSub: After the last sequence, cycle back to #1. Great for tubes & socks.
wizard.step4Empty: No sequences yet — go back to Step 3 or reuse one from your library.

customStitch.blurb: For anything not in the standard set — grandma's secret rib, your favourite bobble variation.
customStitch.tileColorHint: how it sits next to its neighbours
customStitch.notationPlaceholder: A line or two on how to make this stitch — needle position, yarn-over direction, anything that'll save Future-You a Google.

pickerStitch.title: Pick a stitch
pickerStitch.customPanelBody: Got a stitch that's not in the list — bobble pattern, fisherman's rib variation, your grandma's secret? Define it here.
